title: Abdullah Ibrahim (Dollar Brand) returns from exile

notes: South Africa, English. Cape Town International, 6 Sept 1990: the pianist walks off the aircraft after years of exile, then sits at a press table under a jazz banner and speaks; the reel closes on his raised salute and the crowd. No piano is played on the tape — all speech and room. Fetched from the page's flat MP4, recordFiles/207-784-332/34x007-H.264LAN.mp4.
